test_title: PYST 5: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight girls - L, M, N, O, P, Q, R and S - were seated in two rows, one facing the north, the other facing the south. Each row had only four chairs. There is equal distance between adjacent persons. Each person in a row faces another person from the other row. Q and P were diagonally opposite to each other. M was opposite to P. R was to the immediate right of L. S was second to the right of M. N was at one of the extreme ends of the row. Who among the following girls was sitting opposite to O?
solution:
Given: Eight girls - L, M, N, O, P, Q, R and S - were seated in two rows, one facing the north, the other facing the south.

Each row had only four chairs. There is equal distance between adjacent persons.

Each person in a row faces another person from the other row.

1) S was second to the right of M.

2) M was opposite to P.

3) Q and P were diagonally opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6efac40341d9f654e86b8d0b7292b39ad24232559dd7707ab3a10a4035e2692.png] 

4) N was at one of the extreme ends of the row.

5) R was to the immediate right of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e835dc1a7c9449eb2a6adefdfaf859ac44b1e96282428fdb6fda075892eee176.png] 

And, O will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51863f911c4fcbd7c936449b620e508923d3ac8178af27363a345f22ee28d940.png] 

So, 'R' was sitting opposite to O.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
